descriptionChirho: The emotion of resentful desire for what another possesses or hostility arising from such desire. All grammatical forms (singular N-AMS/N-NMS/N-DMS/N-GMS and plural N-NMP/N-AMP) carry the same lexical meaning with no semantic differentiation: spa 'envidia/envidias', hin 'daah/irshya' (jealousy/envy), arb 'hasad' (envy/jealousy), kor 'sigi' (envy/jealousy), swa 'wivu/husuda' (jealousy/envy). The plural forms simply denote multiple instances or acts of envy rather than a distinct sense.
